doc.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier and Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-01-18

title: Photographing the grip
summary: Williams explains the fingers holding the stick (the first finger and thumb carry it, the third and fourth are free) while Cie photographs his hands and arranges the microphone.
